name: extracted marker
summary: When a commander record is extracted from a document, the record id is appended to the record flag in that document as a signal that it has been extracted, in the form CA:{Extracted: CA-XXX}.
statement: When a commander record is extracted from a document, a signal is left to indicate that it has been extracted. Append the record ID to the record flag. eg `CA:{Extracted: CA-XXX}`
context: Written by the commander under a Commander Response heading inside XX-001, beside CA-047 and CA-049. Until this advice, a record written inside a pilot document stayed frozen with no sign of whether it had reached the corpus; this makes extraction visible at the source. The three responses inside XD-001 (CO-089 to CO-091) and the three inside XX-001 are the first to carry the marker.
